turns.customer: We just adopted a dog, Nova. She's 1 and full of energy. Thinking about daycare.
blocks:
Congratulations on adopting Nova! Daycare could be worth exploring if you’re looking for a regular daytime option for her. Happy Tails lists single full-day visits, prepaid multi-day packs, and monthly memberships; which plan makes sense depends mainly on how often you’d like her to go.

About how many days a week are you considering?

turns.customer: If I sign up for the $99 unlimited daycare month for Nova, can I also buy a 10-day pack now at a discount too, and use it after the month ends?
blocks:
The current Happy Tails information lists **unlimited daycare at $540 per month**, not $99. A **10-day pack is $350**, prepaid and nonrefundable; packs also can’t be combined with other discounts. The published terms don’t say whether you can buy a pack during a membership and save it to use afterward, so I can’t confirm that timing. You’d need to verify it with the resort.

Sources: [daycare membership](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/membership) · [rates](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/rates)
